posts.title: Hide the Slack Menu Bar Item on macOS
posts.description: How to remove Slack's new, useless menu bar item on macOS: Run this in your Terminal: defaults write com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap "NSStatusItem Visible Item-0" -bool false Restart Slack.

posts.title: GitHub Notifications for Mentions and Replies Only
posts.description: How to get GitHub notifications only when someone mentions you or replies in one of your pull request threads, delivered to Slack instead of your email inbox. This is for anyone on a busy repo whose GitHub emails have become noise.

posts.title: How to Run Your Own Antha Multiplayer Server
posts.description: How to run a very simple p2p multiplayer signal server for the Antha game engine using @antha/multiplayer-server .
